Title: Azure Synapse Runtime for Apache Spark 3.2 End of Support

Body.Content: End of Support for Azure Apache Spark 3.2 was announced on July 8, 2023.  We recommend that you upgrade your Apache Spark 3.2 workloads to version 3.3 (GA) or 3.4 (GA expected in Q1/Q2 2024). Azure Synapse runtime for Apache Spark 3.2 will be retired and disabled as of July 8, 2024.
